newsitem.title: USA: Iatros sees profitability by year end.
newsitem.headline: Iatros sees profitability by year end.

text.p: Iatros Health Network Inc said Friday said it was "cautiously optimistic" it would return to profitability by year end after reporting a loss for the first six months.
Iatros reported a net loss of $0.53 per share for the first half of the year against a profit of $0.10 for the same period last year.
It had a net loss of $0.47 per share for the second quarter against a profit of $0.06 a year ago.

"The second quarter net loss reflects $6.7 million in write downs," it said in a statement. "With this series of write downs we foresee no substantial additional asset write-offs occurring. The worst is behind us. The majority of the ongoing restructuring effort was accomplished in the second quarter, and we anticipate only minimal residual carry over possible in the third quarter in the form of severance pay and employee benefits.
"We are cautiously optimistic we will move towards profitability by the year-end quarter while continuing to grow revenue in 1997," it added.
Iatros Health Network provides management and health care ancillary services.
